execution.default_mode: synthetic in-memory self-test; no archive reads
execution.receipt_creation: O_EXCL; exactly one receipt and no response materialization
execution.reviewed_source_binding: Execution requires a separately created exact-schema intent binding the committed Git HEAD, candidate-source raw SHA-256, plan raw SHA-256, and both archive hashes.
validation_reads: the exact-hash independently authored recovery-v6 semantic checker

fallback_rule.direct_assigned_list: Require exactly one valid _Assigned_chem_shift_list row for the BMRB entry, with one valid assigned-list ID and one valid Sample_condition_list_ID.
fallback_rule.experiment_resolution: Every valid Chem_shift_experiment assigned-list ID must equal the direct ID, and at least one must do so. A row with a valid Experiment_ID and a missing, invalid, or other assigned-list ID is rejected. Every complete matching Experiment_ID resolves to zero or one Experiment row; duplicate matches are rejected.
fallback_rule.preferred_linkage: Fallback is forbidden if any matching Experiment row has a valid Sample_condition_list_ID. It is permitted only when every complete-link resolution is absent or has a missing or invalid condition pointer.
fallback_rule.ph: At the direct condition list, require exactly one numeric pH row in [0,14], with Val_units exactly pH or empty. Missing, invalid, contradictory, or additional pH rows remain HOLD.

metadata_scope: Target-unread reinterpretation of fixed recovery-v6 metadata only. No network, source construction, coordinate construction, OpenMM execution, score inspection, target inspection, or authorization consumption is permitted.
metadata_resolution_limit: A resolved metadata pointer or deposited pH cannot establish protonation feasibility, all-atom feasibility, support feasibility, or science feasibility.
warnings: Preferred Experiment-loop condition linkage always takes precedence over the direct assigned-list fallback.
Present-but-ambiguous preferred linkage is not absence and never authorizes fallback.
No metadata result is a science, support, protonation, or all-atom clearance.
